ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 The Dig — Skyrail Exchange — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
The Dig / Skyrail Exchange
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Each player places three 25 mm Hyperthermal Techs before deployment, completely outside 8 inches of both DZs and other Techs, on accessible ground; do not pre-fix them.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/16de25e7-8317-4d7c-8438-bd4284164855
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.

end
